baseline_models.focus_anchor: min al-layl, sabbihhu, and adbar al-sujud
baseline_models.mechanism: A portion of darkness and the after-part of prostration become two recurrent stations, distributing worship across duration and aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Night as darkness supplies the first temporal station.
Worship through praise or prayer supplies the repeated action.
The ending and passing aftermath supply the second station.
Bodily abasement identifies the act whose aftermath remains charged.

changed_reading.before: Glorify Him at otherwise unspecified times.
changed_reading.after: Give both a portion of night and the wake of prostration their own recurring praise.

baseline_models.mechanism: Outcome-attentive d-b-r and free-ranging s-b-h let bowed surrender govern the activity released after the posture, rather than ending with it.

activation_trace.role: Looking to an affair's consequence turns the after-part into lived follow-through.
Submission and lowering supply the orientation to be carried onward.
Room to move through livelihood supplies the domain into which that orientation continues.

changed_reading.before: Add praise once prostration has finished.
changed_reading.after: Let prostration's surrendered orientation shape the conduct that follows it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: the bodily sequence in sabbihhu wa-adbar al-sujud
baseline_models.mechanism: Bending creates a low point; its after-phase releases swimming or running movement, so praise marks bodily re-entry into motion.

activation_trace.role: Bowing and head-lowering supply the downward phase.
The after-phase supplies the turn beyond the low point.
Swimming and running supply released forward movement.
Undertaking an activity at night situates the kinetic sequence in lived time.

changed_reading.before: Praise is a static utterance attached to a completed posture.
changed_reading.after: Praise animates the transition out of bowing and back into movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Restraint interrupts reactive speech, while repeated tasbih and praise redirect the mouth toward clearing and commending God; the focus verse makes that response recur at night and after prostration.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from panic supplies the brake on reaction.
Speech brought out in utterance supplies the verbal pressure being answered.
The repeated command to clear God of wrong attribution supplies redirected utterance.
Praise as the opposite of blame gives the redirected speech positive content.
The focus imperative carries that clearing speech into recurring stations.

structural_cues: 50:39 places patience over what they say immediately before praise, and 50:40 continues the praise schedule.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies others' speech, restraint, praise, and adjacent repeated sabbih; I infer a causal rerouting from reaction into praise. A live alternative is that these are parallel duties without a speech-conversion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a self-contained devotional schedule.
changed_reading.after: The schedule is also a repeated counter-speech discipline that converts verbal pressure into praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Praise anticipates sunrise and sunset, extends within darkness, and continues after bodily descent; the sequence weaves before, during, and after rather than listing equivalent clock points.

activation_trace.role: Twice-repeated precedence supplies the anticipatory edge of the rhythm.
The luminary's rising supplies the opening cosmic threshold.
The sun supplies the visible carrier of the daily cycle.
Sunset supplies the closing cosmic threshold.
Darkness extends praise beyond the visible solar arc.
The after-part adds a retrospective edge following prostration.

structural_cues: 50:39-40 move from qabl twice to min al-layl and then adbar, changing the phase relation from before to within and after.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered temporal markers and bodily aftermath; I infer deliberate phase-weaving between cosmic and postural transitions. They may instead be independent conventional worship appointments.

changed_reading.before: Night and post-prostration are two extra times added to dawn and dusk.
changed_reading.after: The focus verse completes an asymmetric rhythm that prepares for transitions and preserves praise after them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Habitual return, including return with night, combines with vigilant continuance: the night portion and post-prostration aftermath become a homecoming loop that restores and guards orientation.

activation_trace.role: Coming and returning with night makes darkness a recurrent homecoming rather than empty time.
Adherence and regular continuance supply the preserving function of repetition.
Habitual return supplies the repeated inward turn.
Night provides the recurring temporal container for return.
The aftermath of prostration provides a second point of restoration.
Praise and prayer enact the return and preserve it.

structural_cues: 50:32-33 pair awwab and hafiz with a munib heart; 50:40 supplies repeatable night and postural stations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, night-return, regular preservation, and the focus schedule; I infer a feedback loop in which praise restores orientation. The descriptors may instead characterize persons generally without specifying this practice.

changed_reading.before: The verse assigns additional worship slots.
changed_reading.after: Each night and each post-prostration interval functions as a return point that renews and guards the heart's direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act of voicing praise sits immediately before commanded listening, the caller, and the heard cry, forming a call-and-response discipline in which devotional speech trains compliant hearing.

activation_trace.role: Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies receptive readiness.
The raised call supplies the voice to which readiness must answer.
Auditory perception realizes the trained receptivity at the decisive moment.
The alarming cry supplies the climactic sound event.
Voiced worship supplies the active response side of the circuit.
The focus aftermath becomes the hinge before the command to listen.

structural_cues: 50:40 is immediately followed by istami, and 50:41-42 repeat hearing around a caller and a cry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and a voice-hearing chain; I infer that recurrent praise rehearses responsiveness to the final summons. A live alternative is a simple scene transition with no training relation.

changed_reading.before: The worshipper only produces praise in the appointed interval.
changed_reading.after: The interval joins utterance to listening, training a worshipper to answer a summons rather than merely make sound.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps worship posture onto the nearby resurrection sequence. It remains anchored because the focus branches visibly supply bending, an after-phase, and released movement, while the context supplies exit, opening, and gathering. Render it only as an embodied analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the verse or an exclusive reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: sujud as bending, adbar as the after-phase, and sabh as released movement

activation_trace.role: Bending and lowering supply a bodily descent.
The aftermath supplies the phase change beyond descent.
Swimming or running supplies renewed motion after the low point.
Passing outward supplies the emergence analogue.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the sequence's destination.
Splitting open supplies the breached enclosure through which emergence occurs.
Driving and gathering to one goal supplies the collective endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Praise simply follows a completed prostration.
changed_reading.after: The bowed body rises into praise as a small embodied rehearsal of emergence and gathering.

strongest_changes: 50:39 turns the schedule into disciplined counter-speech under verbal pressure.
The awwab-hafiz-munib cluster recasts night and post-prostration as a return-and-preservation loop.
50:41-44 opens a call-response reading and, more cautiously, an embodied emergence analogy.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse acts as a hinge across before, within, and after; speech and hearing; and bodily descent and renewed movement, while each reading remains attached to its four focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: Adbar al-sujud may function only as a conventional time label rather than an active aftereffect.
The nightly-return branch and the bodily resurrection analogy are branch-enabled inferences, not forced lexical senses.
The caller sequence may be a narrative transition rather than evidence that praise trains hearing.
